title: SAE Experimentation & Analysis
summary: This module provides a comprehensive suite for experimenting with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), including running various experiments, analyzing causal impacts of features, and optimizing Sparse Steering Vectors (SSVs).

nodes.label: SAE Experiment Runner
nodes.title: SAE Experiment Runner
nodes.description: Orchestrates a full suite of experiments for Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), including data generation, encoding, attribution, auto-interpretation, validation, reconstruction analysis, and ablation studies.

nodes.label: SAE Causality Analysis
nodes.title: SAE Causality Analysis
nodes.description: Provides tools for analyzing the causal impact of specific SAE features on model activations, including decoding sparse latent representations and applying causal intervention hooks.

nodes.label: SAE Optimization Scripts
nodes.title: SAE Optimization Scripts
nodes.description: Provides scripts for optimizing Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) Sparse Steering Vectors (SSV) and evaluating their performance in steering language models.

nodes.label: SSV Analysis Scripts
nodes.title: SSV Analysis Scripts
nodes.description: Provides scripts for analyzing Sparse SAE Vectors (SSVs), including clustering features and generating corpus-based interpretations for better understanding of model behavior.

groups.label: Experimentation Core
groups.title: SAE Experimentation Core
groups.description: The central component for orchestrating and running various Sparse Autoencoder experiments, from data generation to validation.

groups.label: Analysis & Interpretation
groups.title: SAE Feature Analysis and Interpretation
groups.description: Modules dedicated to understanding the causal impact of SAE features and interpreting Sparse Steering Vectors through clustering and corpus analysis.

groups.label: Optimization Tools
groups.title: SAE Optimization Tools
groups.description: Scripts and functionalities focused on optimizing Sparse Steering Vectors (SSVs) derived from SAEs to enhance model steering capabilities.
